example_sentences_in_bangla: আকাশে কালো জলধর জমে উঠেছে, বৃষ্টি হবে বলে মনে হচ্ছে।
বঙ্গোপসাগরকে প্রাচীন কবিরা জলধর বলে অভিহিত করেছেন।
example_sentences_in_english: Dark clouds are gathering in the sky, it seems like rain is coming.
The Bay of Bengal was referred to as a water holder by ancient poets.
note: This term originates from Sanskrit and is commonly used in Bengali literature to poetically describe clouds or vast bodies of water.
